asset.name: MediaPlayer
asset.description: The unified audio and video player with custom controls, captions, chapters, quality and speed selection, preview scrubbing, keyboard shortcuts, and a native fallback.

requires.reason: Scales, palettes, spacing, and motion resolve to declared ramps.
Scrubbing and volume use the shared range control.
Transport controls are shared icon actions.
Position and outcome are announced through the one shared live region.

signatureMoment.description: Scrubbing shows a live preview frame at the pointer position and releases exactly there, so seeking is aimed rather than guessed.

rationale: Captions are a hard requirement rather than a feature: a media player in a component library that treats caption rendering as optional will produce inaccessible products by default.
